scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Closed finer cached reference, local mesh qualification/failures and exact zero controls

fine_reference_equivalence.scope: Compare every saved inertial state and every unaveraged corner tensor after a solver change.
fine_reference_equivalence.limitations: Same complete physical inputs and original full mapped/body dynamic force gates; all original field states and unaveraged corner tensors are compared. This qualifies reference numerical equivalence only, not physical convergence, full-arm matching or an accuracy-cost operating range.

mesh_qualification.scope: Audit contact-centered local refinement geometry before assembling larger FEM solves.
mesh_qualification.limitations: Geometry and mesh-size qualification only. Fixed polyhedral geometry, material and physical contact protocol are unchanged. Stress/contact convergence and a resolved physical patch require solved fields and independent tails.

limitations: The complete physical goal remains active. Ten closed runs include four failed mesh diagnostics and both exact zero controls. Custom tie candidate changes boundary area and is removed; no accepted physical solve uses it. Fine cached equivalence and fixed-polyhedron mesh checks do not establish contact/stress convergence. Finer local/U/full-egg studies are live and excluded. Full articulated application matching, all original A/B/C, model/feedback separation and warmed accuracy/cost remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
